units.source_text: 朱雀院对其他几位公主并不操心，也没有求婚人前来烦扰他。

en.t: Suzaku-in did not worry much about his other princesses, and no suitors came to trouble him about them.

units.source_text: 惟关于三公主婚事，虽在深宫中秘密商谈，不知怎的自会流传出去。

en.t: But the matter of the Third Princess's marriage somehow spread outside, even though it was discussed secretly deep within the palace.

units.source_text: 于是有许多人都想来攀亲了。

en.t: As a result, many people began hoping to form a marriage connection with him.

units.source_text: 太政大臣想道：“我家的右卫门督至今还是鳏居。

en.t: The Grand Minister thought, My Captain of the Right Gate Guards is still living alone as a widower.

units.source_text: 他打定主意非皇女不娶。

en.t: He has made up his mind that he will marry no one unless she is an imperial princess.

units.source_text: 现在朱雀院正在替三公主择婿，我们何不前去奏请。

en.t: Now that Suzaku-in is choosing a husband for the Third Princess, why should we not go and submit a request?

units.source_text: 倘幸蒙选中，我也面目增光，真乃一大喜事也。”

en.t: If he is fortunate enough to be chosen, it will bring honor to me as well, and it will truly be a great joy.

units.source_text: 他心里这样想，口上也这样说。

en.t: This was what he thought in his heart, and this was also what he said aloud.

units.source_text: 便叫他的夫人——尚侍胧月夜的姐姐——去请托胧月夜向朱雀院转达此意。

en.t: He then asked his wife, the elder sister of Oborozukiyo, the Naishi no Kami, to petition Oborozukiyo to convey this wish to Suzaku-in.

units.source_text: 胧月夜恳切奏闻，说尽千言万语，希望朱雀院准奏。

en.t: Oborozukiyo presented the matter earnestly, exhausting every possible argument in the hope that Suzaku-in would grant the request.

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王曾经想娶玉鬘，终于被髭黑左大将夺去。

en.t: Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War, had once wished to marry Tamakazura, but in the end she was taken by Higekuro, the Left Captain.

units.source_text: 此后他决心不娶寻常女子，以免被髭黑夫妇所笑。

en.t: After that, he resolved not to marry an ordinary woman, lest Higekuro and his wife laugh at him.

units.source_text: 他正在选妻，闻知朱雀院择婿的消息，岂有不动心之理，为此日夜萦思，不胜焦灼。

en.t: Since he was just then looking for a wife, how could he fail to be moved when he heard that Suzaku-in was choosing a son-in-law? He thought of it day and night and was deeply restless.

units.source_text: 还有藤大纳言，多年来为朱雀院当家臣，常得亲近其左右。

en.t: There was also Fuji no Dainagon, who for many years had served Suzaku-in as a household retainer and had often been allowed close attendance on him.

units.source_text: 但今后朱雀院入山修道，他就失却靠山，孤苦无依。

en.t: But once Suzaku-in entered the mountains to devote himself to religious practice, he would lose his patron and be left lonely and without support.

units.source_text: 因此希望当了三公主的保护人，依旧得蒙恩顾，正在盼望朱雀院垂青。

en.t: For that reason he hoped to become the Third Princess's protector and continue receiving favor, and he was waiting for Suzaku-in to look kindly on him.

units.source_text: 还有中纳言夕雾，听到此种消息，想道：“我并非听人传言，却是朱雀院亲口对我恳切劝诱的。

en.t: Then there was the Middle Counselor Yugiri, who heard this news and thought, This is not something I heard as a rumor; Suzaku-in himself earnestly urged it upon me in person.

units.source_text: 我只要找个适当的中间人，向他表示我也有此意，他难道会拒绝我么！”

en.t: If only I find a suitable intermediary and let him know that I too have such an intention, would he really refuse me?

units.source_text: 他有些儿意马心猿。

en.t: His heart became somewhat unsettled and restless.

units.source_text: 既而又想：“我的妻子现在已经真心诚意地信赖我了。

en.t: Before long, however, he thought again, My wife now trusts me with complete sincerity.

units.source_text: 过去多年来，我大可拿她的薄情为借口而抛弃她，然而我并未将心移向别的女子。

en.t: For many years in the past, I could easily have used her coldness as an excuse to abandon her, yet I never turned my heart toward another woman.

units.source_text: 那时尚且如此，现在岂可突然变节，使她伤心呢！

en.t: If I was faithful even then, how could I suddenly change now and break her heart?

units.source_text: 况且和高贵无比的公主缔姻之后，万事皆不能随心所欲。

en.t: Besides, once I formed a marriage tie with an incomparably noble princess, nothing would be entirely at my own disposal.

units.source_text: 要我兼顾云居雁和三公主，势必两不讨好，我身也太苦劳了。”

en.t: If I tried to care for both Kumoi no Kari and the Third Princess, I would surely please neither of them, and the burden on me would be far too heavy.

units.source_text: 夕雾原是个秉性诚实的人，关于此事，他只在心中默想，并不说出口来。

en.t: Yugiri was by nature an honest man, so regarding this matter he merely pondered it in his heart and did not speak of it aloud.

units.source_text: 然而听到三公主将另择他人为婿的消息时，未免心中不快，常常注意倾听。

en.t: Yet when he heard that the Third Princess might choose someone else as her husband, he could not help feeling displeased and often listened closely for news.
